anchors.name: selection-spanning-a-link
anchors.why: The link tail is skipped as one unit; its innards are not markup characters and would otherwise stop the scan.

anchors.name: repeated-phrase-disambiguated-by-context
anchors.why: The quote occurs three times, and the selection is the SECOND. Nothing but the context can distinguish them, so both sides have to weigh it the same way — picking the first occurrence is the failure this case exists to catch.

anchors.name: cyrillic-with-emoji
anchors.why: An emoji is two UTF-16 units and four UTF-8 bytes, so it separates the two coordinate systems in the other direction from Cyrillic.

anchors.name: combining-accent
anchors.why: "café" written as e + U+0301 is two code points and one glyph. Neither side may end an offset between them.

anchors.name: ascii-control
anchors.why: The negative control for the fixture itself: on ASCII the coordinate systems coincide, so this case passing proves nothing on its own. It is here to show the suite is not merely ASCII.
